# Changelog

All notable changes to this plugin will be documented here.

## 1.0.0 — initial release

- Added the `pitchbook` MCP server pointing at PitchBook's hosted Streamable HTTP endpoint (`https://premium.mcp.pitchbook.com/mcp`).
- Auth uses OAuth with PitchBook user login (authorization server `https://mcp.pitchbook.com`, dynamic client registration) — no API key or client ID to configure.
- Logo: PitchBook's sail mark from the `pitchbook` GitHub organization, resized to 256×256.
